text: haha this prompt might get me put on some list but fuck it, how do we make epic explosives (in the game)
resolution: Foundation for the 'epic explosives' feature, scoped with the user to two pure, fully-tested game doors (no host rebuild) since every named effect is the same mechanic at different settings. game/explosion.ts (GAME_EXPLOSION) is the instant radial-blast solver: center+radius+peak impulse/damage over a target list returns falloff impulse (for physics velocity), falloff damage, and ignition flags, with near-edge distance (wide cars catch near misses), upward debris throw, mass resistance, and cover shielding via the same world-LoS contract chance.ts uses. game/fire.ts (GAME_FIRE) is the lingering/spreading model: a Combustible burns fuel then cooks off into a blast or extinguishes (propane = fuel~0 + cookoff = instant boom; car = multi-second GTFO window + cookoff), and a sparse FireField does tile-grid gasoline-trail spread that crawls cell-to-cell and stops where fuel stops, deterministic under a seeded rng. Both own one registered P2 tuning table; magnitudes are per-call. 26/26 behavior tests pass, wired into the game barrel. User chose 'both' spread models and 'foundation + tests' scope. Follow-up layers (own requests): prop/vehicle combustible tags, RPG projectile + gas-trail trigger, fireball Effect VFX + camera shake.
